subtitle: Your photo. Half dog.

iap.description: Five extra Dogg Style photos. Credits do not expire. Invalid photos and errors do not use a credit.
iap.reviewScreenshot: Use 04-result or a StoreKit product screenshot of the pack.

description:
Add a photo. Dogg Style makes a picture that’s half you, half dog.

The first one is free. After that, buy five more for $2.99 — a one-time In-App Purchase, not a subscription.

• Take a selfie or pick a photo
• We send it to our AI only to make your result
• Save and share with a Dogg Style mark
• Restore purchases in Info
• Clear photos stored on this phone anytime

Entertainment only. Not a scientific or medical result. Not for children under 13.

Camera is optional. You can pick a library photo instead. We don’t post your photo publicly, we don’t use it for ads, and we don’t sell it.
promotionalText: First dog photo is free. Five more for $2.99 — no subscription.
whatsNew: First App Store release. Apple In-App Purchase for extra photos, restore, and on-device photo deletion.
reviewNotes: No login. First generation is free — please use Camera or Photo, then Create. Extra photos are a $2.99 consumable IAP (com.doggstyle.pack5). Restore is under Info. Website Stripe checkout is not used in this iOS binary. Support: Info → Support, or the Support URL. Demo photo is not required; any clear photo of one person works.

photos.usedFor: Sent to our AI provider (xAI) to generate the dog portrait. Not posted publicly.

screenshots.spec: 1320x2868 JPEG, sRGB, no alpha. Apple scales to smaller iPhone sizes.

stillRequiredOutsideThisRepo: Xcode on a Mac: npx cap add ios, copy native/ios/IapPlugin.swift, Info-usage.plist keys, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, DoggStyle.storekit
App Store Connect: create IAP com.doggstyle.pack5 as Consumable $2.99
Replace YOUR-DOMAIN in privacy/support URLs with the live site
